source_text: Neonatal circumcision exhibits significantly lower complication rates compared to procedures performed in adulthood, with systematic reviews reporting adverse events in infants ranging from 0.0008% to 3.6%, often limited to minor issues like bleeding or infection, versus 0.9% to 8.8% in adults, where risks include more severe outcomes such as excessive skin removal or prolonged healing. [14]
